2.1: PatQueryRepository.recordUse is a QueryDSL update (no SQL string, so SqlConfinementTest's rule holds) of last_used_at, last_used_ip and use_count = use_count + 1, guarded by last_used_at IS NULL OR < usedAt, @Transactional on the impl because the caller is an executor thread. PatUsageTracker now takes PatQueryRepository instead of PatRepository (it used the latter only for this write). mvn -o -pl :pat-spring-boot-starter test: 123 run, 0 failures.

2.2: PatUsageRaceIT exposed a second lost update the design had not named: the revoke's full-row Hibernate UPDATE wrote the stale last_used_at (null) back over the concurrent write (assertion at line 107: expected NOW, was null, while revoked_at was set). Fixed with @DynamicUpdate on PatEntity so each writer touches only its own columns. After it: PatUsageRaceIT 3/3 pass (revoke, rotation, forward-only).

3.1 (cause): reproduced on the first of 30 loop runs (under the parallel PAT loop's load): StubFaultIT.slow saw 1 request in 10 s. The client logged only 'attempt=1 failed after 404ms: java.net.http.HttpTimeoutException: request timed out' - the retry was never attempted. A passing run logs 'java.io.IOException: Request timed out' caused by java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException on both attempts. On the JDK transport the HttpClient's own request deadline and Spring's future timeout race on the same read-timeout; TransportFailures.isRetryable listed TimeoutException but not java.net.http.HttpTimeoutException (an IOException), while isTimeout listed both. So a timed-out GET was retried only when Spring's timer won. Production defect in rest-client-spring-boot-starter, not a test-timing issue; the design's journal-reset hypothesis was wrong.

SCOPE CHANGE (3.2): the fix is in rest-client-spring-boot-starter (TransportFailures.isRetryable gains java.net.http.HttpTimeoutException, plus RetryPolicyTest.retriesJdkClientTimeoutOnGet), a module the proposal did not name. Fixing the shared root cause is what task 3.2 asks for; the alternative (changing the test) would hide a production retry defect. The gate therefore adds `mvn -pl :rest-client-spring-boot-starter -am verify` and its in-repo dependents crud-service-example, export-spring-boot-starter, reconciliation-spring-boot-starter (test-support-local already listed). RetryPolicyTest 16/16.
